name: influenza-sego2022
title: Influenza infection & immune response (Sego 2022 reproduction)
lead:
A native viva-cpm reproduction of Sego et al. 2022's cellularized influenza
model, built up increment-by-increment (a 10-increment capability ladder,
see how_to_read) from a bare epithelial sheet to the full multiscale
composite at 1 mm^2 paper scale. The CC3D source (ViralInfectionVTM) is the
authoritative parameter/spec reference, cross-checked against the paper's
own tables; Increment 0 establishes that authority and records where the
two disagree, before any engine code exists.

at_a_glance.role: Increment 0: establishes the cited parameter authority, provenance docs, and digitized figure targets; documents open source-vs-paper discrepancies. No simulation.
Increment 1: validates the confluent epithelial-sheet substrate (geometry + 1mm^2 throughput) as a process-bigraph composite. Substrate only — no biology reproduction claim.

Increment 2: validates the virus field (diffusion/decay) + stochastic H->I infection MECHANISM (local spread, population conserved) over the Increment-1 sheet. Mechanism only — no resistance/IFN/immune cells yet, and no Figs 3B/5/7 reproduction claim (still PENDING, Increment 9).

Increment 3: validates the type-I IFN field + per-cell resistance MECHANISM gating virus secretion by (1-resist) over the Increment-2 virus-field/infection path — PRIMARY evidence is total_virus roughly halved (~53% at step 20 through ~58% at step 40); n_I is a weaker, corroborating signal at the tested step (~4% at step 20, widening to ~23% by step 40). Mechanism only — death/recovery/Allee/IL-10/immune cells/APC-driven IFN amplification not yet modeled; resist plateaus ~0.55 (not ~1), an OPEN Increment-9 calibration question; no Figs 3B/5/7 reproduction claim (still PENDING, Increment 9).

Increment 4: validates the full epithelial-fate lifecycle MECHANISM — infection (H->I) + infected death (I->D) + cellularized Allee death/recovery (H<->D) over the Increment-2/3 path. Dead lesion grows via H->I->D (n_D 0->14 at 200 updates, 0->77 at 500 updates); Allee recovery (D->H) confirmed bidirectionally correct (deterministic + organic evidence, 3-12 events/run). Mechanism only — direct Allee death (H->D) is honestly reported as essentially absent at 0.3mm scale (verified genuine, not a bug, via rate instrumentation), an OPEN Increment-9 calibration flag; NK/CD8+ contact-killing, chemokine/IL-10 fields, other immune cells, and APC-driven IFN amplification not yet modeled; no Figs 3B/5/7 reproduction claim (still PENDING, Increment 9).

Increment 5 (RE-SCOPED ahead of chemokine/IL-10 fields — see the 5/6 re-scope note below): validates the macrophage (type M) chemotactic-LOCALIZATION MECHANISM — macrophages chemotax up the unchanged Increment-2 virus field via the engine's existing linear-lambda primitive and accumulate at the infection, robust across 5 seeds (5, 17, 23, 42, 100) with an unbiased interior-placed control (Task 5.1 fix round 1, commit 4092d7c): mean distance-to-infection change -13.39 sites (range -11.52 to -17.75), negative in 5/5 seeds, chemotaxis on, vs a near-isotropic lambda=0 control (mean -0.85, range -4.99 to +3.45); chemotaxis-on beats the control in every seed. Localization only — NO virus phagocytosis (the CC3D source itself has none, a paper-vs-source discrepancy, honestly recorded), NO recruitment dynamics (a fixed population is placed at scenario build time; chemokine/APC-Hill-driven recruitment is Increment 6/8), a 5-seed (modest) ensemble, 2D-approximation geometry, and the engine's linear (not the source's saturating/COM) chemotaxis form; no Figs 2/3A reproduction claim (still PENDING, Increment 9).

Increment 6: validates the chemokine + IL-10 diffusible-FIELD MECHANISM over the Increment-5 macrophage scenario (Task 6.1, commit 48c96c1) — macrophage-released chemokine (Hill-self-regulated) forms a spatial gradient CENTERED ON THE MACROPHAGE CLUSTER, confirmed two independent ways: per-cell 0.00261 at macrophages vs 0.00062 far (4.2x), and a raw-lattice radial profile decaying monotonically 0.00195 -> 0.00033 across 6 distance bins (5.9x). IL-10 is positive and increasing from BOTH regulated sources (macrophages 2.97e-4 Hill-self-regulated, uninfected cells 3.71e-5 1-resist-gated). Field mechanism only — sig_1 is a documented constant STUB (the source's true value is TNF/global-ODE-dependent, Increment 8), g_1/g_2 use the 0.3mm-scenario eta approximation (Increment 8/9), global boundary secretion terms and IL-10's uniform initial condition are deferred (Increment 8/9), and NO chemotaxis toward the new chemokine gradient is wired yet (Increment 7's scope); no Figs 2/3A-adjacent reproduction claim (still PENDING, Increment 9).

Increment 7: validates NK/CD8 chemotactic-LOCALIZATION (robust across 5 seeds — NK mean distance change -20.37 vs a lambda=0 control's -1.02, CD8 -35.99 vs -0.54, CD8 localizing more strongly matching the paper's 2x-sensitivity claim) AND the contact-killing MECHANISM (a small close-contact scenario clears an infected cell, 1 -> 0) as two independently-correct mechanisms — but HONESTLY reports that at the scenario's own DEFAULT full scale NK/CD8 never reach actual contact with the infected cell within the run budget, so end-to-end cytotoxic CLEARANCE is WEAK/not demonstrated there (n_infected unchanged): killing CAPABILITY proven, end-to-end clearance an Increment-9 field-magnitude-calibration gap, the same root cause as the localization mechanism's own 100x chemotaxis engine-unit-scale correction. Also flags discrepancy #7 (resist-DIRECT kill-rate multiplier), deferred nearby-population killing term (Increment 8), and unmodeled haptotaxis; no Figs 2/3A-adjacent reproduction claim (still PENDING, Increment 9).

Increment 8: adds the Price (2015)-derived global (whole-organ) immune ODE — 10 systemic species, integrated once/MCS, coupled bidirectionally to the spatial CPM patch — and RESOLVES the three stubs carried since Increments 5-7 into dynamic, source-faithful mechanisms: sig_1 is now DYNAMIC (ODE TNF + spatial dead count, the unchanged Increment-6 Michaelis form), recruitment is ODE-driven (chemokine/APC Hill inflows, CD8's no-baseline asymmetry preserved), and NK/CD8 killing gains a well-mixed NEARBY-population term alongside the Increment-7 LOCAL term. HONESTLY reports that at this reduced-scale patch (eta ~1.4e-4) none of the three mechanisms' MAGNITUDES yet reconcile with the values they replaced or need to matter within a feasible run — dynamic sig_1 collapses ~6 orders of magnitude below the retired static stub (2.44), recruitment stays sub-0.01/MCS (baseline-dominated only, no signal-driven integer growth), and nearby-killing is too weak to fire via natural recruitment buildup (verified via a documented test seam instead): mechanism-resolved, calibration PENDING Increment 9. No Figs 3B/5/7 reproduction claim (still PENDING, Increment 9).

how_to_read:
Read this top-down as a capability ladder, not a finished result:

1. INCREMENT 0 (this scaffold) — spec authority & targets, no engine code.
   Acquire the CC3D source, transcribe Tables 1-4 into a cited params.yaml,
   digitize Figs 3B/5/7 into acceptance bands, record source-vs-paper
   discrepancies. Study: parameter-provenance (documentation only).
2. INCREMENTS 1-8 — one capability + one study + one paper target each,
   validated at reduced (0.3 mm) scale: epithelial sheet, virus field +
   infection, IFN + resistance, death/recovery, macrophage response,
   chemokine/IL-10 fields, NK/CD8+ cytotoxic killing, global ODE coupling.
   (Increments 5/6 were RE-SCOPED/swapped from the original ladder order —
   see the note in biological_story below.)
3. INCREMENT 9 — the capstone: full composite at 1 mm^2 paper scale, 50
   replicas, evaluated against the Increment-0 acceptance bands for Figs
   3B (time series vs ODE), 5 (viral-load sweep, lethal threshold), and 7
   (infection-fraction sweep). This is the "reproducibility achieved"
   deliverable — not yet reached.

Full ladder detail: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-18-influenza-sego2022-reproduction-design.md §5.

biological_story:
Sego et al. 2022 built a cellularized, multiscale model of local influenza
infection: a 2-D epithelial sheet (Cellular Potts) is infected by a
diffusing virus field, mounts a type-I interferon response that confers
per-cell resistance, and recruits macrophages, NK cells and CD8+ T cells via
chemokine gradients to clear infected cells — all coupled bidirectionally to
a global ODE compartment (Price 2015) that scales the spatial patch to a
physiological lung-epithelium population. It is a rich, independently
published, source-available target for testing whether a from-scratch CPM
engine (viva-cpm) can reach genuine quantitative reproduction of a
real spatial-immunology model, not just a qualitative phenomenon.

The investigation treats the paper's own CompuCell3D supplementary source
(ViralInfectionVTM) as the ground-truth spec, not just the paper's printed
tables — because the source is what actually produced the published
figures, and the two disagree in eight places (neighbor order, two
immune-adhesion entries, lattice-size defaults, the initial-viral-load
sweep encoding, a simplified death-rate term, an asymmetric resistance
usage, and a qualitative-vs-numeric label mismatch on macrophage
chemotaxis). Recording these discrepancies up front, before any engine code
exists, is the point of Increment 0: later increments build on a stated,
auditable authority rather than an implicit blend of "whichever value
looked right."

Capability accrues on a 10-increment ladder: epithelial sheet at scale,
virus field + infection, IFN + resistance, epithelial death/recovery,
macrophage response, chemokine + IL-10 fields, NK/CD8+ cytotoxic response,
the global ODE coupling, and finally the full capstone reproduction against
Figs 3B, 5, and 7 at paper scale with 50 replicas.

NOTE — Increments 5/6 RE-SCOPED (recorded at Task 5.2, macrophage-response
study): the ladder as originally scaffolded put "chemokine + IL-10 fields"
at position 5 and "macrophage response" at position 6. Actual build order
swapped them — Increment 5 is now macrophage response (this study) and
Increment 6 will be chemokine + IL-10 fields. Rationale: the core
macrophage chemotactic-LOCALIZATION mechanism (chemotax up the ALREADY-
EXISTING Increment-2 virus field toward the infection, via the engine's
existing `World.set_chemotaxis` primitive) needed no new field and no new
Rust code, so it was cheaper and more legible to validate FIRST, isolated
from recruitment dynamics. Increment 6 will build the chemokine C field and
Hill-driven macrophage recruitment (replacing this study's FIXED
macrophage population with actual inflow/outflow); the APC-driven (P)
recruitment/global-IFN-amplification piece stays part of Increment 8's
global ODE coupling, as originally scoped. This changes the ladder's build
ORDER only, not its content — all 10 mechanisms are still planned, and no
scope was dropped.
question:
Can viva-cpm's native Cellular Potts engine reproduce, to quantitative figure
match, the cellularized multiscale influenza-infection and immune-response
model of Sego et al. 2022 — built on CompuCell3D's ViralInfectionVTM — at
paper scale (Figs 3B, 5, 7)?
hypothesis:
A CPM composite that reproduces the paper's cell types (epithelial,
macrophage, NK, CD8+ T), diffusible fields (virus, type-I IFN, chemokine,
IL-10), per-cell resistance/state transitions, and coupling to the global
immune ODE compartment — parameterized from the CC3D source
(ViralInfectionVTM) as ground truth, cross-checked against the paper's own
tables — will land within the paper's reported acceptance bands for
infected/uninfected/dead epithelial counts and immune-cell trajectories
across the initial-viral-load and initial-infection-fraction scenario
sweeps.

acceptance_criteria.behavior: Parameter authority is established and cited
Confluent epithelial sheet holds stable geometry (~25 sites/cell) and 1mm^2 throughput clears the perf-gate floor (200.0 MCS/s)

Virus field diffuses/decays and a seeded lesion spreads locally via stochastic H->I infection (new infections within a few diffusion lengths of prior-infected cells), with population conserved and no spontaneous infection absent a seed/field

Type-I IFN field drives a per-cell resistance scalar (resist = f_bar/(a_rf+f_bar)) that gates virus secretion by (1-resist), measurably reducing total virus vs the same-seed no-IFN run (primary evidence, roughly halved: ~53% at step 20 through ~58% at step 40), with a weaker, later-emerging reduction in infected-cell growth (n_I: ~4% at step 20, widening to ~23% by step 40) and mean_resist > 0 once IFN accumulates

Infected death (I->D) and the cellularized Allee effect (H->D death / D->H recovery, gated by local contact geometry and resistance) compose with infection into a coherent, population-conserving epithelial-fate lifecycle: a dead lesion grows via H->I->D (n_D 0->14 at 200 updates, 0->77 at 500 updates), a dead cell fully surrounded by healthy tissue recovers, a dead cell surrounded by dying tissue never recovers, and direct Allee death is honestly reported as rare at reduced scale (a recorded Increment-9 calibration flag, not a wiring bug)

Macrophages (type M), wired to chemotax up the (unchanged) virus field via the engine's existing linear-lambda chemotaxis primitive, LOCALIZE to the infection over a 40-update run, robust across 5 seeds (5, 17, 23, 42, 100) with an unbiased interior-placed control (Task 5.1 fix round 1, commit 4092d7c): mean distance-to-infection change -13.39 sites (range -11.52 to -17.75), negative in 5/5 seeds, chemotaxis on, vs a near-isotropic lambda=0 control (mean -0.85, range -4.99 to +3.45, no consistent sign); chemotaxis-on beats the control in every individual seed and the mean gap exceeds the control's own spread; confirmed both by the full scenario and a minimal 2-cell engine-sanity check. Localization mechanism only — no phagocytosis (source has none), no recruitment dynamics (fixed population), a modest 5-seed ensemble

Macrophage-released chemokine (Hill-self-regulated) forms a spatial gradient CENTERED ON THE MACROPHAGE CLUSTER over a 15-update run (seed=17): per-cell 4.2x higher at macrophages than a far uninfected epithelial patch (0.00261 vs 0.00062), and a raw-lattice radial profile decays monotonically 5.9x across 6 distance bins from the macrophage-cluster centroid (0.00195 -> 0.00033). IL-10 is positive and increasing from BOTH its regulated sources (macrophages 2.97e-4 Hill-self-regulated, uninfected cells 3.71e-5 1-resist-gated). Field mechanism only — sig_1 is a documented constant stub (TNF-dependent true value deferred to Increment 8), g_1/g_2 use the 0.3mm-scenario eta approximation, global boundary terms and IL-10's uniform IC are deferred, and no chemotaxis toward the field is wired yet (Increment 7)

NK (type K) and CD8+ T (type E) cells, chemotaxing up the (unchanged) chemokine field, LOCALIZE to the infection robustly across 5 seeds (NK mean distance change -20.37 vs a lambda=0 control's -1.02; CD8 -35.99 vs -0.54, negative in 5/5 seeds each, CD8 localizing more strongly per its 2x lambda). Contact-killing (killing.contact_kill_rate, the source's literal LOCAL surface-contact form) is a verified-correct mechanism: a small close-contact scenario clears the one infected cell (1 -> 0) with killing enabled vs steady at 1 disabled, same seed. HONEST GAP: at the scenario's own DEFAULT full scale (same 6-macrophage/6-NK/6-CD8 scenario the localization numbers come from), NK/CD8 close much of the distance but never reach actual contact within the run budget, so n_infected stays unchanged — end-to-end cytotoxic clearance is NOT demonstrated at this scale, reported honestly rather than tuned away (an Increment-9 field-magnitude-calibration item, same root cause as the 100x chemotaxis engine-unit-scale correction)

The 10-systemic-species Price-2015 global ODE (NB/N/T/X/A/B/P/W/G/O) integrates stably once/MCS, coupled bidirectionally to the spatial CPM patch — spatial aggregates feed the ODE, the freshly-integrated TNF + spatial dead count feeds a DYNAMIC sig_1 (replacing the Increment-6 static stub), ODE-driven recruitment activates/removes CPM immune cells (CD8's no-baseline APC-driven asymmetry preserved exactly, inflow==0.0 with the signal zeroed), and NK/CD8 killing gains a well-mixed NEARBY-population term (verified via a documented test seam: both seeded infected cells cleared within 2 MCS given a large synthetic nearby population) alongside the unchanged Increment-7 LOCAL term. HONEST GAP: at this reduced-scale patch (eta ~1.4e-4), none of the three mechanisms' MAGNITUDES yet reconcile — dynamic sig_1 (~6.04e-7 to ~2.82e-6) is ~6 orders of magnitude below the retired static stub (2.4412677); ODE-driven recruitment produces sub-0.01/MCS chemokine/APC-signal-driven rates (no observable integer growth there; a boosted eta seeds cells but from the homeostatic baseline, not the signal); and the nearby-killing term, grown via natural recruitment alone over 300 MCS, stays orders of magnitude too weak to fire (K_nb~0.16-0.17, E_nb~0.011) — a field-vs-ODE unit-scale calibration gap, the same root-cause category as the cytotoxic-killing study's chemotaxis-engine-scale correction, reported honestly rather than tuned away (an Increment-9 item)

executive.what_is_this:
A ground-up native reproduction of a published cellularized multiscale
infection model (Sego, Mochan, Ermentrout & Glazier 2022, J. Theor. Biol.
532:110918), used as a rigor exercise for viva-cpm's CPM engine: can it
reach quantitative figure match against a real, independently-published
spatial immunology model, using the authors' own CompuCell3D source as
ground truth rather than just the paper's prose? The investigation is
structured as a 10-increment capability ladder (Increment 0 spec/targets,
1-8 individual mechanisms at reduced scale, 9 the full capstone
reproduction) so reproducibility accrues cumulatively and each step is
independently reviewable.
executive.verdict:
Increments 0-7 of 10 landed (5/6 RE-SCOPED — see biological_story;
Increment 5 is macrophage response, Increment 6 is chemokine/IL-10
fields); reproduction fidelity NOT yet assessed. The
parameter/spec authority is established (pbg_cpm_studies/influenza/params.yaml,
cited to the CC3D source and the paper's Tables 1-4) and figure-target
acceptance bands are digitized for Figs 3B, 5, 7 (Increment 0). The
confluent epithelial-sheet substrate holds stable geometry and steps fast
enough at scale (Increment 1). The virus field diffuses/decays and a
seeded lesion spreads LOCALLY via a stochastic H->I transition, with
population conserved (Increment 2, mechanism-only — no resistance/IFN,
death/recovery, or immune cells yet). A type-I IFN field now drives a
per-cell resistance scalar that gates virus secretion by (1-resist),
roughly HALVING total virus versus the same-seed no-IFN path (the
primary, robust quantitative evidence — ~53% at step 20 through ~58% at
step 40) with a weaker, later-emerging reduction in infected-cell count
(~4% at step 20, widening to ~23% by step 40) (Increment 3,
mechanism-only — resist plateaus ~0.55 rather than saturating toward 1,
an OPEN Increment-9 calibration question recorded not resolved;
death/recovery, Allee effect, IL-10, immune cells, and APC-driven IFN
amplification are all still absent). Infected death (I->D) and the
cellularized Allee effect (H->D death / D->H recovery) now compose with
infection into a coherent epithelial-fate lifecycle: a dead lesion grows
via H->I->D (n_D 0->14 at 200 updates, 0->77 at 500 updates), and Allee
recovery is confirmed bidirectionally correct (a well-surrounded dead
cell recovers, deterministically and organically 3-12 events/run; a
poorly-surrounded one provably never does) (Increment 4, mechanism-only
— direct Allee death is honestly reported as essentially absent at this
reduced scale, verified genuine rather than a wiring bug via rate
instrumentation, and flagged as an OPEN Increment-9 calibration question,
not tuned away; chemokine/IL-10 fields, immune cells, NK/CD8+
contact-killing, and APC-driven IFN amplification are all still absent).
Macrophages (type M) now chemotax up the unchanged virus field and
genuinely LOCALIZE to the infection, robust across 5 seeds against an
unbiased control (mean distance-to-infection change -13.39 sites vs a
near-isotropic -0.85 control) (Increment 5, localization mechanism
only — no phagocytosis, no recruitment dynamics). Macrophage-released
chemokine now forms a spatial gradient CENTERED ON THE MACROPHAGE
CLUSTER (4.2x per-cell near/far, 5.9x radial decay across 6 bins), and
IL-10 is positive and increasing from both its regulated sources
(macrophage Hill-self-regulated, uninfected 1-resist-gated) (Increment
6, field mechanism only — sig_1 is a documented constant stub, no
chemotaxis toward the field is wired yet). NK/CD8+ T cells now
chemotax up the chemokine field and LOCALIZE robustly across 5 seeds
(NK mean distance change -20.37 vs a lambda=0 control's -1.02; CD8
-35.99 vs -0.54, CD8 localizing more strongly, matching the paper's
2x-sensitivity claim), and the contact-killing MECHANISM itself is
verified correct (a small close-contact scenario clears an infected
cell, 1 -> 0) (Increment 7). HONESTLY REPORTED: at the scenario's own
DEFAULT full scale, NK/CD8 never reach actual contact with the infected
cell within the run budget, so end-to-end cytotoxic CLEARANCE is WEAK/
not demonstrated there — the killing capability is proven, but this is
NOT "NK/CD8 clear the infection"; an Increment-9 field-magnitude-
calibration gap, the same root cause as the localization mechanism's
own 100x chemotaxis engine-unit-scale correction. Eight source-vs-paper
discrepancies remain recorded, not resolved. No Figs 3B/5/7
reproduction claim is made — that verdict stays PENDING until
Increment 9 (the capstone).
executive.verdict_detail:
Member study parameter-provenance (Design phase, documentation-only)
establishes the parameter authority: it cites params.yaml, the two
provenance docs (docs/cc3d-reference/sego2022-source-notes.md and
sego2022-parameters.md), and the digitized figure targets
(pbg_cpm_studies/influenza/targets/{fig3b,fig5,fig7}.json). It records,
not resolves, the 8 source-vs-paper discrepancies in
sego2022-parameters.md §7 (e.g. neighbor order 3 vs the expected 2,
Infected-Macrophage adhesion 20 vs the paper's collapsed 10,
NKcell-CD8Tcell adhesion 25 vs the paper's collapsed 10). Member study
epithelial-sheet-baseline (Increment 1) validates the bare confluent
sheet substrate (geometry + 1mm^2 throughput) as a process-bigraph
composite — substrate only, no biology. Member study
virus-field-infection (Increment 2) validates the virus field +
stochastic infection MECHANISM (measured: n_I grows 9->16 over 60
updates from a seeded lesion; spread is spatially LOCAL by a discriminating
null-baseline test — new infections land ~0.61x as far from prior-infected
cells as a uniform-random null (actual 15.0 vs random 24.6 sites), and a
shuffled-field non-local control fails at ~1.13x — population conserved;
null control confirms no spontaneous infection). ifn-resistance
(Increment 3) validates the type-I IFN field + per-cell resistance
MECHANISM (measured, same seed=17/0.3mm/900-cell sheet). The PRIMARY,
robust quantitative evidence is total_virus: with-IFN
819.16/1222.88/1624.58 vs without 1750.69/2752.34/3905.38 at steps
20/30/40 — roughly halved already at step 20 (~53%) through ~58% at
step 40. n_I is a WEAKER, corroborating directional signal at the
tested step (48 vs 50 at step 20, only ~4%), widening to a more
meaningful ~23% by step 40 (53 vs 69) as the effect compounds.
mean_resist engages immediately (~0.53 at step 1) and plateaus at
~0.55-0.57 through step 40 rather than saturating toward 1, an OPEN
Increment-9 calibration/convention question recorded, not resolved.
epithelial-fate (Increment 4) validates the full cell-fate lifecycle
MECHANISM (infection H->I, infected death I->D, cellularized Allee
death H->D / recovery D->H, measured same seed=17/0.3mm/900-cell
sheet). The dead lesion (n_D) grows via H->I->D: 0->14 over 200 updates
(n_H 855->668, n_I 45->218), 0->77 over 500 updates (n_H 855->77, n_I
45->746). Allee recovery (D->H) is confirmed bidirectionally correct: a
deterministic frozen-geometry test proves a well-surrounded dead cell
recovers and a poorly-surrounded one provably never does (recovery rate
exactly 0.0), and the full driver fires recovery ORGANICALLY 3 times
over 200 updates / 12 times over 500 updates. Direct Allee death (H->D
without infection) fires 0 times in both runs — honestly reported, and
verified genuine (not a wiring bug) via rate instrumentation (15,447
qualifying H-cell/update pairs at 500 steps, all correctly positive but
tiny, mean ~1.2e-5, expected ~0.19 successes) — an OPEN Increment-9
calibration question about the b_h/theta asymmetry and per-update (not
per-MCS) batching, recorded not resolved. macrophage-response
(Increment 5, RE-SCOPED ahead of chemokine/IL-10 fields) validates the
macrophage chemotactic-LOCALIZATION MECHANISM (measured, robust across
5 seeds — 5, 17, 23, 42, 100 — with an unbiased interior-placed control,
Task 5.1 fix round 1, commit `4092d7c`): wiring macrophages (type M) to
chemotax up the UNCHANGED Increment-2 virus field via the engine's
existing linear-lambda `World.set_chemotaxis` primitive, mean distance
to the infection centroid DECREASES in 5/5 tried seeds (mean change
-13.39 sites, range -11.52 to -17.75) over 40 updates, while the
identical starting configuration (both the macrophage cluster and the
infection placed in the domain interior, not a wall-pinned corner) with
chemotaxis off (lambda=0 control) shows a small, directionless change
(mean -0.85, range -4.99 to +3.45, near-isotropic) — chemotaxis-on beats
the control in every individual seed, and the mean on/off gap (-12.54)
exceeds the control's own seed-to-seed spread (8.44); confirmed both by
the full scenario and a minimal 2-cell engine-sanity check. Localization
only: NO virus phagocytosis (the CC3D source itself has none — a
paper-vs-source discrepancy, honestly recorded, not a gap introduced
here), NO recruitment dynamics (a fixed 6-macrophage population is
placed at scenario build time; chemokine/APC-Hill-driven recruitment is
Increment 6/8), a 5-seed ensemble (a modest sample, not a full
statistical power analysis, an OPEN Increment-9 item), a non-confluent
2D approximation of the source's z=2 immune-layer geometry, and the
engine's LINEAR (not the source's saturating/COM-scaled) chemotaxis
form. No reproduction verdict against Figs 3B/5/7 or Fig 2/3A exists
yet — that begins at Increment 9 (the capstone).

Layered on the validated Increment-2/3 virus field + infection + IFN-
resistance path: does wiring ALL epithelial fates together -- infection

death / D->H recovery, both gated by local contact geometry and

dead lesion grows via H->I->D and dead cells surrounded by healthy

The full fate lifecycle (infection H->I, infected death I->D, Allee
death/recovery H<->D, all wired together each update) composes into a
coherent, mass-conserving mechanism: the dead lesion grows steadily
over both a 200- and 500-update horizon, driven overwhelmingly by the
infection->death path (H->I->D), with population exactly conserved
throughout. This is the study's central confirming result.

deterministic isolated test and organically within the full driver.

actually engages under realistic run conditions.

enough draws" -- a dead cell with no healthy neighbors has a

actually observes a death event). Structural causes (b_h/theta
